item_done: the inbox item was filed: nothing was sent
save_failed: the inbox item could not be saved
cannot_reply: this item cannot be replied to
reply_text_only: this device can only reply with text
doc_change_required: ref, field and value are required
answer_only: this device can only confirm a reply or a conclusion as text
suggestion_action: action must be confirm, reject or instruct
parent_kind: parent kind must be inbox, todo or session
parent_id: parent id must be 1–256 printable characters
parent_cycle: that parent would make a cycle
parent_deep: that parent would sit the item too deep (at most 8 levels)
bulk_limit: too many items in one request
bulk_action: action is done, dismiss or reopen
bulk_filter: a filter files open items as of a list: as_of is required, and reopen takes ids
document_only: only document items have a status to change
cannot_mute: this item cannot be muted by that
no_doc_row: this row or status column is not in the item
not_processing: this conversation was not started for an inbox item
cannot_policy: this item cannot get a rule by that
policy_tier: tier must be action, fyi, noise or empty
policy_twin: twin must be first, never or empty
history_limit: limit must be a number from 1 to {max}
history_cursor: before must be an RFC 3339 time, and before_id comes with it
history_zone: tz must be a time zone name, such as Europe/Berlin
bad_folder: folder must have at least one name between the slashes
rules_long: The rules are too long (4000 characters at most)
